title: Sci-Fi
story: Blast off into the future, where rockets, saucers and shiny gadgets rule the screen.

cards.name: Rocket
cards.subject: A tall rocket standing on a launch pad, with a pointed nose cone, a round window, three fins and a nozzle at the bottom.
cards.hero_colors: white body, red nose cone and fins, small blue window
cards.backdrop_colors: clear sky blue with bright green grass
cards.surface_or_setting: launch pad on a grassy field

cards.name: Flying Saucer
cards.subject: A round flying saucer with a glass dome on top, a wide metal disc body and a ring of lights around the rim.
cards.hero_colors: silver gray body, light teal dome, small yellow lights

cards.name: Space Helmet
cards.subject: A round space helmet with a big curved glass visor, a thick neck ring and two side connectors.
cards.hero_colors: white shell, gold tinted visor, small red neck ring

cards.name: Ringed Planet
cards.subject: A round planet with stripes across its surface and one wide flat ring tilted around it.
cards.hero_colors: orange and cream stripes, ring in pale yellow with a thin blue edge

cards.name: Satellite
cards.subject: A satellite with a boxy body, two long rectangular solar panels on either side and a small round dish on top.
cards.hero_colors: gold foil body, dark blue solar panels, small red dish rim

cards.name: Control Panel
cards.subject: A slanted control console with a row of round buttons, two sliders and a small square screen.
cards.hero_colors: light gray body, blue screen, small red button

cards.name: Telescope
cards.subject: A long telescope tube on a three-legged tripod, with a lens at one end and a small eyepiece at the other.
cards.hero_colors: white tube, dark gray tripod, small gold ring on the tube

cards.name: Jetpack
cards.subject: A backpack with two tall cylinder tanks, two nozzles at the bottom and two shoulder straps.
cards.hero_colors: silver tanks, gray straps, small orange nozzle tips

cards.name: Moon Rover
cards.subject: A moon rover with a flat open body, six wheels, a small antenna dish and a camera mast.
cards.hero_colors: light gray body, black wheels, small yellow dish
cards.backdrop_colors: clear bright turquoise sky over pale gray crater ground

cards.name: Space Station
cards.subject: A space station with a central cylinder module, a ring-shaped section, and two large solar panel wings.
cards.hero_colors: white modules, blue solar panels, small orange stripe on the cylinder
cards.backdrop_colors: bright magenta pink and violet space glow with the blue Earth curve below

cards.name: Time Machine
cards.subject: A time machine with a curved seat, a round dial panel, a tall back ring and a flat base platform with two side rails.
cards.hero_colors: brass and silver frame, dark red seat, small blue glowing dial
cards.backdrop_colors: bright sky blue walls with a clean white lab floor

cards.name: Teleport Pod
cards.subject: A tall glass tube with a round metal base and a round metal top ring, and a door panel in the glass.
cards.hero_colors: clear glass, silver base and top, small cyan light on the top ring

cards.name: Hologram Globe
cards.subject: A glowing globe floating above a round base, with a few thin rings circling the globe.
cards.hero_colors: light blue translucent globe, dark gray base, small yellow ring

cards.name: Hoverboard
cards.subject: A rounded board shaped like a skateboard without wheels, with two glowing pads underneath and a curved front tip.
cards.hero_colors: white board, teal sides, small pink glowing pads

cards.name: Atom Model
cards.subject: An atom model with a center cluster of balls and three tilted oval rings, each ring holding one small ball.
cards.hero_colors: silver rings, blue center balls, small orange ball on one ring

cards.name: Microscope
cards.subject: A microscope with a round base, a curved arm, a tall eyepiece tube, a lens barrel and a flat stage.
cards.hero_colors: white body, black eyepiece, small gold knob

cards.name: Energy Cell
cards.subject: A tall cylinder battery cell with a glowing center tube, a metal cap on top and a metal base.
cards.hero_colors: silver cap and base, glowing light green core, small red band near the top

cards.name: Hover Car
cards.subject: A sleek car with a rounded bubble roof, a long smooth body, two tail fins and glowing round pads underneath instead of wheels.
cards.hero_colors: silver body, clear bubble roof, small red tail fins
cards.backdrop_colors: clear bright cyan sky above a city of white towers

cards.name: Radar Dish
cards.subject: A large round satellite dish tilted upward on a short mast, with a small arm holding a receiver in front of the dish.
cards.hero_colors: white dish, gray mast, small orange receiver tip

cards.name: Bubbling Flask
cards.subject: A round-bottom glass flask with a narrow neck, filled with liquid and a few round bubbles rising up.
cards.hero_colors: clear glass, glowing green liquid, small blue cork

cards.name: Space Shuttle
cards.subject: A space shuttle with a pointed nose, large triangular wings, a tall tail fin and three engine nozzles at the back.
cards.hero_colors: white body, black nose and wing edges, small red stripe on the tail fin
cards.backdrop_colors: clear sky blue with a bright green field

cards.name: Comet
cards.subject: A round rocky comet head with a long curved glowing tail trailing behind it.
cards.hero_colors: gray rock head, light blue icy tail, small yellow glow at the head

cards.name: Moon
cards.subject: A big round full moon covered with round craters.
cards.hero_colors: pale gray and cream, craters in light gray, small peach patch

cards.name: Spiral Galaxy
cards.subject: A spiral galaxy with a bright round center and two curved arms swirling outward.
cards.hero_colors: violet and pink arms, white center, small blue edges on the arms

cards.name: Meteorite
cards.subject: A rough lumpy space rock with a few deep dents and a smooth patch on one side.
cards.hero_colors: dark gray rock, rust brown dents, small silver patch

cards.name: Space Boots
cards.subject: A pair of chunky space boots with thick ridged soles, tall rounded tops and two wide straps on each boot.
cards.hero_colors: white boots, gray soles, small blue straps

cards.name: Space Capsule
cards.subject: A cone-shaped capsule with a round window, a flat heat shield at the bottom and a small hatch on the side.
cards.hero_colors: silver gray body, black heat shield, small orange hatch frame

cards.name: Space Helmet
cards.subject: A round space helmet with a big curved glass visor and a thick neck ring.
cards.hero_colors: white shell, gold tinted visor, small blue neck ring

cards.name: Flying Saucer
cards.subject: A round flying saucer with a glass dome, a wide disc body and three short landing legs, hovering over a field.
cards.hero_colors: silver gray body, light green dome, small orange lights on the rim
cards.backdrop_colors: clear bright violet sky over golden wheat field

cards.name: Lunar Base
cards.subject: A moon base made of three round domes joined by short tubes, with a door on the largest dome and a small antenna.
cards.hero_colors: white domes, gray tubes, small teal door
cards.backdrop_colors: bright turquoise sky above pale gray moon ground
